intro: Sickness absence often raises HR and employment law questions. May I extend a contract during illness? What do I do in a conflict? How do I avoid a wage sanction (loonsanctie)?
With React2u Ready you get clear advice from people who know the Dutch rules on sickness absence inside and out. Without detours, and in a form you can act on straight away.
herken: You are unsure whether you may end a contract during illness
A conflict is making the absence complicated

You finally want your absence policy properly on paper
